source.title: fix(browser): capability-aware dispatch with no side-effect replay (#18258)

reason: The exact-head formal review identified three independent release blockers: a production module imported but absent from the committed tree, a bridge capability manifest that advertised operations its executor rejected and could misclassify side-effect uncertainty, and an action boundary that erased the new typed retry-safety state. The author explicitly accepted all three findings, and commit bfe4f2f4ef89ad01f054c1ce9f0258172196062c directly repaired each boundary with the requested module, real-manifest dispatcher regressions, typed action failures, and 216 lines of focused tests before the repaired pull request merged.
